Events

Cultural programme at the Centers

Concerts, screenings, encounters and other cultural proposals find their own context in the Centers. Architecture, volcanic rock, light and landscape accompany what happens and change the way each event is experienced.

Keroxen Lanzarote
Los Sara Fontán + Pura Márquez

Violin, percussion and electronics come together in a live performance open to change. Los Sara Fontán arrive at the Cueva de los Verdes as part of Keroxen Festival, alongside Pura Márquez and her edible installation, which adds a participatory and gastronomic dimension to the experience.
Music and Visual Arts 8:00 pm 60 min 22 October
€20.00
Cueva de los verdes

Keroxen Lanzarote
Waq Waq Kingdom & Kalma

Electronic music, Japanese tradition and real-time visual creation. Waq Waq Kingdom & Kalma arrive at Cueva de los Verdes.
Music and Visual Arts 8:00 pm 60 min 23 October
€20.00
Cueva de los verdes

Matria

It is a project by Caracolas, a musical ensemble rooted in Canarian traditions, resulting from five years of research and the testimonies of 210 women from across the Canary Islands.
Concert 8:00 pm 75 min 24 October
€30.00
Jameos del Agua

Keroxen Lanzarote
Rob Mazurek

Cornet, electronics and improvisation come together in a performance that explores new sonic frontiers. Rob Mazurek arrives at Cueva de los Verdes as part of Keroxen Festival.
Music and Visual Arts 8:00 pm 60 min 6 November
€20.00
Cueva de los verdes

Keroxen Lanzarote
Lagoss + Simone Marine

Experimental electronic music, island imaginaries and interactive audiovisual creation. Lagoss presents Música para Plátanos alongside Simone Marin at Cueva de los Verdes as part of Keroxen Festival.
Music and Visual Arts 8:00 pm 60 min 7 November
€20.00
Cueva de los verdes

Noches de Jameos

Enjoy an evening visit to Jameos del Agua that combines gastronomy, music, and the unique setting created by César Manrique. A different way to discover this extraordinary place.
Night Visit 18:30-20:30 Every Friday
From €88.00
Jameos del Agua

Juan Brito y la Princesa Ico

It brings together Juan Brito's original sculptures to discover Lanzarote's most iconic legends through an interactive experience that combines art, history and technology.
Exhibition 10:30-17:30 Every day
Free
Casa Museo del Campesino

Timanfaya, arte creado por el volcán

A photographic exhibition by José María Barreto showcasing the beauty and uniqueness of Timanfaya's volcanic landscapes through previously unpublished images. Included with admission to Jameos del Agua.
Exhibition 10:00-17:30 Every day
Free
Jameos del Agua

The island’s cultural programme

Cultura Lanzarote

Concerts, exhibitions, cinema, encounters and mediation activities come together on Cultura Lanzarote. An open doorway to follow the island’s cultural programme and discover new ways of approaching what happens inside and beyond the Centers.

FAQs

Prepare your visit

Get answers to your questions about schedules, tickets, access and everything you need to know before your visit to the Centros de Arte, Cultura y Turismo de Lanzarote

At Montañas del Fuego and Cueva de los Verdes, tickets can only be purchased online and always for a specific date and time.

At the other centers, you can buy tickets directly at the ticket office, but we recommend purchasing them in advance to make access easier.

[Tickets here]

Yes. Canary Islands residents can benefit from a special price, as well as residents of Lanzarote and people with disabilities. Please note that these rates cannot be combined and are only available at the ticket offices upon presentation of the required physical documentation.

Some centres do not have a box office. We recommend purchasing your ticket in advance on the website to secure your access to the centre.

It is not necessary to print it, however, you must have the QR code downloaded and ready at the entrance to speed up access.

In some areas coverage is limited, download the ticket on your mobile or take a screenshot of the QR code before arriving.

We are sorry you haven’t automatically received your tickets. We recommend checking your spam folder or ensuring that your email address is correctly entered. If you still can’t find them, please contact our Customer Service department at 901 200 300, via WhatsApp, or by sending an email to info@centrosturisticos.com. Our customer service hours are Monday to Friday, from 08:00 to 15:00.

Yes, it is mandatory for Cueva de los Verdes and Montañas del Fuego. You must select the date and time when completing your online purchase.

You can also, if you are interested in discovering our spaces in a different and more exclusive way, the “Experiencias Insólitas” (our premium guided tours in small groups) require advance online booking with a fixed date and time. – They are offered at Montañas del Fuego and Jameos del Agua.-

For the rest of the Centres and general visits, it is not necessary to book a fixed time. You have full flexibility, although purchasing your ticket in advance helps reduce waiting times and supports a more balanced management of the space.

Still have questions?

Contact our customer service team at info@centrosturisticos.com or by phone at +34 928 84 84 84.
